SELECT tsc.train_id AS trainId, sc.type AS seatType, tsc.carriage_number AS carriageNumber, ts.seat_no AS seatNo, sio.start_sequence, sio.end_sequence, CONCAT(tsc.train_id, '_', sc.type, '_', tsc.carriage_number, '_', ts.seat_no) AS unique_key FROM seat_class sc INNER JOIN train_seat_class tsc ON sc.id = tsc.seat_class_id INNER JOIN train_seat ts ON tsc.id = ts.train_seat_class_id LEFT JOIN seat_interval_occupy sio ON ts.id = sio.seat_id AND sio.status IN (1, 2) -- 仅查有效占用区间（1=锁定中，2=已售出） AND (sio.expire_time IS NULL OR sio.expire_time > NOW()) -- 未过期
(tsc.train_id, sc.type, tsc.carriage_number, ts.seat_no) IN
(#{item.trainId}, #{item.seatType}, #{item.carriageNumber}, #{item.seatNo})
ORDER BY FIELD( unique_key,
CONCAT(#{item.trainId}, '_', #{item.seatType}, '_', #{item.carriageNumber}, '_', #{item.seatNo})
), tsc.carriage_number, ts.seat_no, sio.start_sequence
ORDER BY tsc.carriage_number, ts.seat_no, sio.start_sequence
